overall: Three natural-material volumetric technology concepts. Alpha exterior and holes readable on light/dark/checkerboard backgrounds; no global blue cast, lettering, frame or ground shadow. Not flat PM pictograms.

entries.assessment: Wooden pithead with coherent sheave/rope/winding drum path and one suspended ore bucket. Braced timber load-bearing structure, compact shaft collar. Readable hoisting silhouette at 48/64. A conceptual simplification, not a full technical copy of the museum drawing.
entries.limitations: At 32 px rope and bucket details naturally reduce; the strong headframe silhouette remains.

entries.assessment: Davy-type mesh safety enclosure, guard rods and brass reservoir with restrained contained wick flame; no later glass chimney or electric fittings. Ring opening transparent. Readable at 48/64.
entries.limitations: Fine gauze becomes tonal texture at small size, deliberately subordinate to lamp silhouette.

entries.assessment: Opposite-end inlet/outlet connected into a rectangular iron air chamber, hearth directly beneath, brick flue joined to rear masonry. Fire heat stays below chamber; no steam gauge or boiler drum. Compact conceptual cutaway of air preheating.
entries.limitations: Illustration is deliberately cut away and simplified for icon scale, not a certified engineering reconstruction. Detailed rivets reduce at 32 px.

scope_proof: All 1241 baseline common/gfx files unchanged during lot14 preview preparation. No target DDS exported or bound. Copper chain and seven original laboratory PM icons untouched.
